  fallback rules neither crest (undefined, nulls, closed or empty images): nothing is drawn — not a single canvas call on the page
  long names: crests shrink together, or are left out — never overlap a realistic long 22-character name leaves full-size crests
  long names: crests shrink together, or are left out — never overlap a wider name shrinks BOTH crests by the same factor and keeps a 16 px gap
  long names: crests shrink together, or are left out — never overlap when crests would have to be smaller than 64 px they are left out and the page is untouched
  natural shape and placement (hand-computed sizes, box 140 × 136, area ≤ 120²) aspect ratio is always the artwork's own; the crest is centred on its staging canvas and so on (140, 158)
  natural shape and placement (hand-computed sizes, box 140 × 136, area ≤ 120²) circle 512² → 120 × 120; tall shield 300 × 400 → 102 × 136; wide 512 × 256 → 140 × 70
